# Check for missing values in the relevant columns
print("Missing values:")
print(f"Pressure: {df['pressure'].isna().sum()}")
print(f"Wind Speed: {df['wind_speed'].isna().sum()}")

# Extract the two variables
pressure = df['pressure']
wind_speed = df['wind_speed']

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient and p-value
r_value, p_value = pearsonr(pressure, wind_speed)

print(f"\nPearson Correlation Coefficient (r): {r_value}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")

# Determine significance at alpha = 0.05
alpha = 0.05
is_significant = p_value < alpha

print(f"\nSignificance level (alpha): {alpha}")
print(f"Is significant (p < 0.05): {is_significant}")

# Round the values as required
r_rounded = round(r_value, 2)
p_rounded = round(p_value, 4)
significance_str = "significant" if is_significant else "not significant"

print(f"\nRounded r-value: {r_rounded}")
print(f"Rounded p-value: {p_rounded}")
print(f"Significance: {significance_str}")

# Format the final answer
final_answer_str = f"@correlation_coefficient[{r_rounded}] @p_value[{p_rounded}] @relationship_significance[{significance_str}]"
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {final_answer_str}")
